text.description_html:
Schlage 11-111, A Series Spring Latch Square Corner 2-3/4" Backset

The Schlage A Series Springlatch comes with a 2-3/4 inch backset. The latch faceplate is 1 inches wide and 2-1/4 inches tall. For use with Schlage's Commercial A Series knobs.

Features and Specifications of the Replacement latch for Schlage's Commercial A Series:

  • Faceplate: 1” x 2-1/4” square corner
  • Backset: 2-3/4”
  • Diameter: 7/8

Sold Individually
